question.problem:
A drone has positive velocity $v(t)$ after being flown upward from an initial height of $0$ feet at time  $t=0$ seconds. The velocity of the drone is recorded for selected values of $t$ over the interval $0\le t\le 40$ seconds, as shown in the table below. 

| $t\,\text{(seconds)}$ | $0$ | $7$ | $15$ | $25$ | $32$ | $40$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $v\,\text{(feet/second)}$ | $3$ | $10$ | $25$ | $40$ | $46$ | $49$ |

Use the right Riemann sum over $[0,40]$ with five subintervals to approximate the total distance covered by the drone.

*Hint: The distance traveled is given by the area under the velocity-time graph.*
question.worked_solution:
Let $A$ denote the area under the curve $y=v(t)$ over $[0,40].$ 
In this case, we have $n=3$ rectangles. Using the right Riemann sum, the total distance can be approximated as 

$$
A≈v(7)Δ{t}_{1}+v(15)Δ{t}_{2}+v(25)Δ{t}_{3}+v(32)Δ{t}_{4}+v(40)Δ{t}_{5},
$$

where each $Δ{t}_{i}$ is calculated by considering the step between a particular $t$-value and the previous one, i.e.,

$$
Δ{t}_{i}={t}_{i}-{t}_{i-1}.
$$

We set up a value table that includes the $Δt$'s.

| $t$ | $0$ | $7$ | $15$ | $25$ | $32$ | $40$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $Δt$ | $-$ | $7$ | $8$ | $10$ | $7$ | $8$ |
| $v(t)$ | $-$ | $10$ | $25$ | $40$ | $46$ | $49$ |

We plug in the numbers to approximate the number of liters and get

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ≈10\cdot 7+25\cdot 8+40\cdot 10+46\cdot 7+49\cdot 8 \\  & =70+200+400+322+392 \\  & =1\,384.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, in the given context, the area under the curve represents the total distance covered by the drone. So, the distance is approximately $1\,384$ feet.
